description: This file contains a static utility class 'PdfFileUtility' providing helper functions for file I/O operations related to PDFs, such as generating temporary file names, saving documents, and displaying PDFs. It's primarily used for testing, sample code, or internal utility purposes.

classes.name: PdfFileUtility
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods for temporary filename generation, saving, and viewing of PDF documents, mainly for testing or internal use.

methods.name: GetTempPdfFileName
methods.description: Generates a temporary PDF filename with a specific pattern suffix '_temp.pdf'.

methods.name: GetTempPdfFullFileName
methods.description: Creates and returns a full temporary path for a PDF file, creating the file in the process.

methods.name: FindLatestPdfTempFile
methods.description: Finds the most recent temporary PDF file in a specified directory, optionally searching recursively.

methods.name: SaveDocument
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument to a temporary file and returns its filename.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocument
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument and opens it in the default viewer.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocumentIfDebugging
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument and opens it only if the debugger is attached.

methods.name: ShowDocument
methods.description: Opens the specified PDF file with the system's default viewer, handling Windows, WSL2, and Linux.

methods.name: ShowDocumentIfDebugging
methods.description: Opens the PDF in the viewer if the debugger is attached.
